title: A Robot from the data of GetURDFrobotData; Robot saved to and loaded from HDF5
author: Claude-JG
description: Scripts build the Robot of an imported URDF by hand. Decided: one function of urdfImport creates it with joint limits, friction and tool frame, and the class Robot saves and loads itself as HDF5.
releaseNotes: urdfImport.RobotFromURDFdata creates a Robot from the data of GetURDFrobotData, with joint limits, tool frame and the friction of the URDF file; Robot.SaveToHDF5 and LoadFromHDF5 store it with graphics and textures.
